The theorem is therefore conditional on that extra bridge. | J3: The selector and SU(3) integration authorities close the three axis minima, residual Z2, selected-axis fiber/base split, residual swap, and 3+1 commutant structure, but the runner hard-codes the forward cycle C and the ordered frame E12,E23,E31.
